title: First experience with opium and heroin in Los Angeles
summary: Two Shaw sidemen offered him opium; he sat stoned for fifteen hours and tried heroin about six months later.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What was the first pop like, was it as good as it was supposed to be?
It was fantastic.
Can it be described?
It was just a feeling, an absence of pain, it was a pleasant feeling.
How long did the first one last?

About--I'll tell you, I tried it, I got up and sat on my bed with my back against the wall--this is about nine o'clock in the morning and about twelve o'clock noon, the following day, I moved. I just sat there all
that time, stoned and at peace, comfortable.
You were by yourself?
Yeah.
Well, Hal McKusick was there, I was living with him, but he didn't get into it. I was the one that tried it.
I didn't send for it, I didn't send out to try it, it happened out of the blue, two guys that were in the area who had just hopped some junk found me at my hotel, they were right there.
Musicians?

Yeah, this is when I was living in downtown L.A.; yeah, two of the guys on Artie Shaw's band. They called up, hey, we're in your neighborhood, can we come up, we have to go to the bathroom. I said sure, come on up. They came up, they went in the bathroom and they called me in. I saw that they had this paraphenalia and I asked them what it was all about. They told me they had gotten some opium, raw opium, and they were going to shoot

it up, and I noticed that they cut it into three pieces, and each of them took a fix in front of me, of the piece and there was another piece sitting there, left. I said you better wrap your piece up, you're leaving it there and they said, "no, that's for you." I said, "no, no, I'm afraid of needles, man." "Aren't you curious, you can have it." It was a nice gift."

I said what's it like, tell me about it. I was hooked already at that moment. I really wanted to know--I had watched them and that's how it happened. It appeared suddenly in front of me and there was an opportunity to try it and I took it. After sitting those fifteen hours, the first thing I did was get off the bed and walk to the phone and call one of these guys, the guy that had it, called him and asked him if he had any more and he said yeah; I said can I come over and have some, and he said yeah. That was it.
After that second time I didn't bother with it anymore. I didn't do anything
for months, but maybe six months later I tried it again; the second time it was heroin.
After you came off it the second time, was there an after reaction?
Uh-uh. No.
It was just like waking up?
Yeah. It just wore off and that was it.
